g.text: clock 120 bpm · transpose +0 st · bend ±2 st · basic ch 8 · FX ctrl ch 8 · tempo ctrl ch 0 · sysEx id 5
write gate locked — edits are refused until it is armed
A per-channel edit writes the whole setup dump: the unit “receive[s] and
understand[s] the old setup dump” (spec p. 29), so p2ked reads the live dump,
changes the one field and sends the dump back. The write gate applies and the field
is read back to verify it -- every other byte is the one the unit just sent
(tests/test_messages.py's TestSetupDumpEncoder). No parameter ID is invented: this
writes the dump's own field positions. The first unit contact is `make
test-hardware`'s unmodified-dump round trip, and until it has run no unit has
received one. The ID-based alternative still needs docs/TODO item 47's probe.
w gate · x FX · enter edit · + / - nudge · z undo · Z undo all · esc / q to close
arrows move · enter channel detail, or edit the value under it · a digit types a number · + / - nudge ·
space toggles · s picks a sound · r re-read · e master edit · x master FX · z undo · esc / q to close
